content.text: As there is no continuing work on the Fedora 3 branch this will not be fixed.
But thanks
for documenting this behaviour for any one else out there.
To reproduce:

Construct an inline datastream and attempt to modify it via an HTTPS URL. For example, a MODS datastream with the URL coming from LoC. It's to be noted that doing this process as a managed datastream the requests work as expected.
See below for reproducing:
Create a datastream with the initial version from binary.

vagrant@tophat-vagrant-test: curl -u user:pw -X POST "http://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/test:test/datastreams/managed?controlGroup=M&mimeType=application/xml" --data-binary "<test/>"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><datastreamProfile  xmlns="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/"  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/ http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/datastreamProfile.xsd" pid="test:test" dsID="test"><dsLabel></dsLabel>
<dsVersionID>test.0</dsVersionID>
<dsCreateDate>2018-07-16T13:43:56.849Z</dsCreateDate>
<dsState>A</dsState>
<dsMIME>application/xml</dsMIME>
<dsFormatURI></dsFormatURI>
<dsControlGroup>X</dsControlGroup>
<dsSize>15</dsSize>
<dsVersionable>true</dsVersionable>
<dsInfoType></dsInfoType>
<dsLocation>test:test+test+test.0</dsLocation>
<dsLocationType>INTERNAL_ID</dsLocationType>
<dsChecksumType>DISABLED</dsChecksumType>
<dsChecksum>none</dsChecksum>
Create a datastream version from HTTP.

vagrant@tophat-vagrant-test: curl -u user:pw -X PUT "https://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/test:test/datastreams/test?dsLocation=http://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/v3/modsejournal.xml"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><datastreamProfile  xmlns="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/"  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/ http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/datastreamProfile.xsd" pid="test:test" dsID="test"><dsLabel></dsLabel>
<dsVersionID>test.1</dsVersionID>
<dsCreateDate>2018-07-16T13:44:39.972Z</dsCreateDate>
<dsState>A</dsState>
<dsMIME>application/xml</dsMIME>
<dsFormatURI></dsFormatURI>
<dsControlGroup>X</dsControlGroup>
<dsSize>1364</dsSize>
<dsVersionable>true</dsVersionable>
<dsInfoType></dsInfoType>
<dsLocation>test:test+test+test.1</dsLocation>
<dsLocationType>INTERNAL_ID</dsLocationType>
<dsChecksumType>DISABLED</dsChecksumType>
<dsChecksum>none</dsChecksum>
Create a datastream version from HTTPS.
vagrant@tophat-vagrant-test: curl -u user:pw -X PUT "http://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/test:test/datastreams/test?dsLocation=https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/v3/modsejournal.xml"
This pops the following in the fedora.log.

WARN 2018-07-16 10:49:09.291 [http-bio-8080-exec-21] (DatastreamResource) Could not retrive content from https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/v3/modsejournal.xml due to error: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unexpected error: java.security.InvalidAlgorithmParameterException: the trustAnchors parameter must be non-empty
java.lang.Exception: Could not retrive content from https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/v3/modsejournal.xml due to error: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unexpected error: java.security.InvalidAlgorithmParameterException: the trustAnchors parameter must be non-empty
	at org.fcrepo.server.rest.DatastreamResource.addOrUpdateDatastream(DatastreamResource.java:550) [fcrepo-server-3.8.1.jar:na]
	at org.fcrepo.server.rest.DatastreamResource.modifyDatastream(DatastreamResource.java:351) [fcrepo-server-3.8.1.jar:na] and so on.
Working on managed as follows:
Create a datastream with the initial version from binary.

vagrant@tophat-vagrant-test: curl -u user:pw -X POST "http://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/test:test/datastreams/managed?controlGroup=M&mimeType=application/xml" --data-binary "<test/>"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><datastreamProfile  xmlns="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/"  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/ http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/datastreamProfile.xsd" pid="test:test" dsID="managed"><dsLabel></dsLabel>
<dsVersionID>managed.0</dsVersionID>
<dsCreateDate>2018-07-16T13:55:11.028Z</dsCreateDate>
<dsState>A</dsState>
<dsMIME>application/xml</dsMIME>
<dsFormatURI></dsFormatURI>
<dsControlGroup>M</dsControlGroup>
<dsSize>7</dsSize>
<dsVersionable>true</dsVersionable>
<dsInfoType></dsInfoType>
<dsLocation>test:test+managed+managed.0</dsLocation>
<dsLocationType>INTERNAL_ID</dsLocationType>
<dsChecksumType>DISABLED</dsChecksumType>
<dsChecksum>none</dsChecksum>
Create a datastream version from HTTP.

vagrant@tophat-vagrant-test: curl -u user:pw -X PUT "http://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/test:test/datastreams/managed?dsLocation=http://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/v3/modsejournal.xml"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><datastreamProfile  xmlns="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/"  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/ http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/datastreamProfile.xsd" pid="test:test" dsID="managed"><dsLabel></dsLabel>
<dsVersionID>managed.1</dsVersionID>
<dsCreateDate>2018-07-16T13:56:22.226Z</dsCreateDate>
<dsState>A</dsState>
<dsMIME>application/xml</dsMIME>
<dsFormatURI></dsFormatURI>
<dsControlGroup>M</dsControlGroup>
<dsSize>1355</dsSize>
<dsVersionable>true</dsVersionable>
<dsInfoType></dsInfoType>
<dsLocation>test:test+managed+managed.1</dsLocation>
<dsLocationType>INTERNAL_ID</dsLocationType>
<dsChecksumType>DISABLED</dsChecksumType>
<dsChecksum>none</dsChecksum>
Create a datastream version from HTTPS.

vagrant@tophat-vagrant-test: curl -u user:pw -X PUT "http://localhost:8080/fedora/objects/test:test/datastreams/managed?dsLocation=https://www.loc.gov/standards/mods/v3/modsejournal.xml"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><datastreamProfile  xmlns="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/"  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/ http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/datastreamProfile.xsd" pid="test:test" dsID="managed"><dsLabel></dsLabel>
<dsVersionID>managed.2</dsVersionID>
<dsCreateDate>2018-07-16T13:56:55.225Z</dsCreateDate>
<dsState>A</dsState>
<dsMIME>application/xml</dsMIME>
<dsFormatURI></dsFormatURI>
<dsControlGroup>M</dsControlGroup>
<dsSize>1355</dsSize>
<dsVersionable>true</dsVersionable>
<dsInfoType></dsInfoType>
<dsLocation>test:test+managed+managed.2</dsLocation>
<dsLocationType>INTERNAL_ID</dsLocationType>
<dsChecksumType>DISABLED</dsChecksumType>
<dsChecksum>none</dsChecksum>
</datastreamProfile
Digging around it's likely in this area where trustStore needs to be accounted for:
https://github.com/fcrepo3/fcrepo/blob/master/fcrepo-server/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/server/rest/DatastreamResource.java#L545

fields.summary: Setting content from an HTTPS URL on an inline datastream causes trustStore exceptions

comments.body:
As there is no continuing work on the Fedora 3 branch this will not be fixed.

But thanks Jordan Dukart for documenting this behaviour for any one else out there.
